title: off-road 南側低空
description: RFC D6 route type 5. A low, curving path over the sparse southern edge of the M1 slice. WHAT THIS MEASURES TODAY: terrain (FTP-40) does not exist yet, so beneath this camera is the grey ellipsoid shell boot.ts sets, with only scattered NLSC buildings at the edges. It is therefore a near-empty-scene baseline, which is genuinely useful for D1 but is NOT yet an off-road driving measurement. Its meaning changes once FTP-40 lands terrain tiles under it, and the numbers from before and after must not be compared.
